title: Search for an app in the Mac App Store
summary: Search the Mac App Store for an application by name and see its price. This is useful for finding apps or checking costs before installing.

aliases.text: find app in mac app store
найти приложение в mac app store

steps.explain: Search for an application by name. The --price flag shows the cost of the app.

placeholders.name: APP_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the application to search for

steps.expect: A list of matching applications with their prices.
